apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: 7.0.0 — the war chest. The whole rig in one chest, remotes for your own gear at the Helm, operations in the War Room, a SIGINT station fusing everything the phone can hear, and War Games for your two phones to spar. EMCON's score now starts from presence itself — and the Banshee, its opposite pole, screams on every channel at once. Spoofy dresses the device in its own costumes and class-shaped mimicry personas, and Skelli is wired to every war room.
